en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a substantial multi‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, set along a curved tree‑lined road. The lower part of the building is of stone, the upper part plastered, with a decorative gable at the center. A walled entrance with a small gatehouse stands to the right, where several uniformed figures are gathered. At the bottom left a printed caption identifies the location and military unit, and a red handwritten number appears at the top center margin.
